items.title: Increase application availability: Configure Linux iSCSI multipath with ALUA for Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
items.summary: When you run production workloads on block storage attached using iSCSI, relying on a single network path between your compute and storage creates an unacceptable single point of failure. For example, if the only path between your Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instance and your Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system fails because […]
